headword: {生活用品|せいかつようひん}
gloss: daily necessities; household goods; everyday items

definitions.gloss: daily necessities; household goods; everyday items
definitions.explanation: daily necessities; household goods; everyday items

examples.japanese: {生活用品|せいかつようひん}を{買|か}いに{行|い}く。
{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}し{先|さき}で{必要|ひつよう}な{生活用品|せいかつようひん}をリストにした。
examples.english: I made a list of daily necessities needed at the new place.

examples.japanese: {被災地|ひさいち}に{生活用品|せいかつようひん}を{届|とど}ける{ボランティア|ぼらんてぃあ}が{集|あつ}まった。
examples.english: Volunteers gathered to deliver daily necessities to the disaster-affected area.

notes:
A general term for items used in everyday life such as toiletries, cleaning supplies, kitchen items, and personal care products. Commonly seen in store signage and shopping contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {生活用品|せいかつようひん}{売|う}り{場|ば}: daily necessities section (in a store)
- {生活用品|せいかつようひん}を{揃|そろ}える: to get one's daily necessities together
- {生活用品|せいかつようひん}の{支援|しえん}: providing daily necessities (as aid)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {日用品|にちようひん}: daily goods — very similar in meaning; {日用品|にちようひん} is slightly more common in everyday speech
- {生活|せいかつ}{必需品|ひつじゅひん}: daily necessities — emphasizes the essential, indispensable nature of the items
- {消耗品|しょうもうひん}: consumable goods — items that are used up and need replacing, such as tissues or batteries
